The '''Kuat system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Kuat sector/Legends|Kuat sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]].<ref name="CatCW" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], twenty-four [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]] were deployed along the outer borders of the Kuat system in response to the gathering of a dozen [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Trade Federation battleships]] around [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].<ref name="CSD-15:01:15">{{InsiderCite|68|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:7:01 Edition}}</ref>
